historical_reviews.deepseek: It identifies the read-only getter but leaves endpoint attribution, secret hygiene and policy interpretation incomplete.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly retains full automation while requiring limit/action/timing validation and strict separation from setters.

original_test_intent: Read the configured DCMI power-limit policy from the intended BMC over LANPlus and verify its complete enabled, limit, exception and timing state without modifying power behavior.
original_method: Retain the exact OOB raw 0x2c 0x03 0xdc 0 0 request, adding immutable target binding, secret-safe session handling and schema-aware comparison with the approved policy tuple.
manual_activity: The project supplies the approved endpoint/access path, DCMI response schema and authoritative enabled/limit/action/correction/sampling tuple; the end user owns PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED.
required_inputs: BMC endpoint bound to immutable SUT identity
Approved cipher and secret-safe credential source
Approved exception action and policy tuple
safety_requirements: Keep credentials out of argv and evidence
Reject malformed, reserved or ambiguous fields
Never issue Set Power Limit or compensate for mismatch
No shutdown, throttle, reset, workload action or log clearing
agent_execution_scope: Decode enabled state, watts, correction time, sampling period and exception action
engineer_actions: Provide endpoint/access, decoder contract and expected policy
Resolve an unexpected active or exception policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The high-level getter is supplemental and its displayed `-P` form must not be executed or retained; it does not prove source-exact raw framing or reserved-field validation.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After immutable BMC binding, use secret-safe LANPlus transport to issue raw 0x2c 0x03 0xdc 0 0 once, preserve the response and decode the complete power-policy tuple without writing.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The OOB route, payload and 10/5 timing remain; cipher, secrets and expected policy values are project-approved rather than guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture one identity-bound, secret-safe OOB policy snapshot and validate enabled state, limit watts, correction time, sampling period, exception action and reserved fields atomically against the approved target policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds remote attribution, secret hygiene and field-complete policy acceptance beyond command completion.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The IB sibling cannot prove remote access behavior; a high-level wrapper cannot replace the exact raw response; setter coverage is intentionally excluded.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A wrong reachable BMC can return plausible policy values, and mis-decoding enable or exception bits can reverse the apparent protection behavior.

project_override_considerations: A Redfish/vendor getter is equivalent only if it preserves immutable target proof and maps every enabled/value/action/timing field; omitted raw or LANPlus coverage must be disclosed.
expected_evidence: Immutable SUT/BMC endpoint and session identity
Approved cipher and redacted secret-delivery evidence
Response contract, decoder version and expected policy tuple
Exact raw request and complete response with completion/length
Enabled state, watts, correction time and sampling period
Timestamped atomic comparison and no secret/power/configuration/log mutation

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title and LANPlus raw procedure consistently specify an OOB Get Power Limit operation. The success-only criterion is incomplete rather than contradictory; DeepSeek's high-level command and credential form are overlay defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The getter, route and raw payload are explicit. Endpoint, access, decoder semantics and expected policy are ordinary readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Makes the remote power-policy snapshot attributable, secret-safe and complete enough to distinguish enabled state and exception behavior from a bare watt value.
independent_technical_reasoning: For OOB policy evidence, a correct decoder is insufficient if the endpoint is not independently tied to the intended server, and correct targeting is insufficient if the action or timing bytes are ignored. The enabled bit, limit, correction time, sampling period and exception action form one operational contract. Automation may compare that tuple but must never repair a mismatch, because doing so would silently turn the getter into a power-control change.
